title: DesignIndexDocumentUpsertedPayload
description: design.index_document.upserted v1 (OpenVibe.Design server/search-index.js, via openvibe-publishing/search-feed). The OpenVibe.Search document of a Design page: an icon (type icon, /icons/<name>, the glyph name as the id: its name, the words it is found by and the formats it downloads in) or a theme (type theme, /t/<slug>: its name, mode and description, from OpenVibe.Network's theme catalog). Sent by the sweep at boot and on a timer; a page that left the catalog becomes a tombstone. The sequencer (design_index_revisions) gives an unchanged document its old revision and nothing is sent. Always visibility public and publication_state published. Facets: kind (icon: solid when it has a filled form), mode (theme). Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type, id, revision }, visibility internal, actor service:design.
